selection: step-in from bonsai1/L22/N7665- (10x queue, model pilot: sonnet)

neighbours.label: Determiners and comparison words (your, his, her, a, of, like) that set up a body part or a physical size comparison
fire: To stretch the calf, place your right foot behind you and press the heel flat.
The hailstones were as large as a golf ball and dented the roof.
He slept on the sofa with his arm hanging over the edge.
The fish measured about the length of your forearm and weighed little.
Cup the ball in your palm and let it rest against your fingertips.
The tunnel was roughly the width of a small car and twice as dark.
She sat upright with her hands folded in her lap and her chin raised.
Lay the patient down with his legs raised above the level of the heart.
quiet: To stretch the calf, lean forward gently and press the heel flat.
The hailstones were large and heavy and dented the roof.
He slept on the sofa until noon, exhausted by the long drive.
The fish was caught early and weighed very little.
Cup the ball gently and let it rest against the wall.
The tunnel was narrow and twice as dark as the corridor.
She sat upright, silent and attentive, as the speaker began.
Lay the patient down and monitor the heart rate every few minutes.
